(3) The repairs or measures mentioned in sub-section (1) shall not be deemed to include such repairs or measures without which the premises are not habitable or usable except with great inconvenience, like keeping them wind and water-tight. The landlord shall be bound to make such repairs or take such measures in any event. On his failure to do so the provisions of sub-section (1) and (2) shall apply without the limitation as to the amount deductable or recoverable as provided in the said sub-sections. 

 21. It was, therefore, evident that apart from the other conditions to be satisfied before the rule can be applied in a particular case, the claim demanded to be set off must be legally recoverable from the plaintiff. The sum claimed as set-off which is; barred by limitation or barred under some other law cannot be deemed- to be legally recoverable.
